results.objective: Go to http://localhost:4173, enter 120 in the Bill amount field, set Tip percent to 15, set Number of people to 3, click Calculate, then verify the page says Each person pays $46.00
results.summary:
The calculation page treats a value as though it were a number when it is not, so it stops before it can display the amount each person owes.
Fix the calculation result handling so all form values are converted to numbers before formatting the per-person amount, then add coverage for 120, 15%, and 3 people.
evidence: console_error: n.toFixed is not a function
results.oneLiner: Calculate does not show the per-person amount for valid inputs because the page errors while formatting the result.
results.reason: Valid inputs were confirmed and Calculate clicked twice, but no result text or result element appears.
